verdict.rationale: Wrike documents a drag-and-drop Kanban board view and a table view, and says users can 'view project schedules at a glance', which only implies a timeline-style view. Calendar and timeline views are not named, and nothing states that these are switchable views of the same work. missing for 10: explicit calendar view, explicit timeline/Gantt view, evidence of switching between views over the same work set, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can switch between board, list, calendar, and timeline views of the same work

citations.quote: See your work in our easy-to-understand, drag-and-drop Kanban board view.
Our table view offers the flexibility and collaboration you need in a format you’re familiar with.
view project schedules at a glance
